versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the YieldVault Agent for BNB Chain.
- Supports deterministic, auditable yield farming decisions with smart contract integration.
- Automated transaction execution (DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, HARVEST, COMPOUND, REBALANCE) on a scheduled (hourly) cycle.
- Built-in risk management (risk_score ≤ 0.5) and yield optimization (net APR calculation).
- Real-time Telegram alerts for actions, APR changes, errors, and cycle summaries.
- Comprehensive configuration, test workflows, and documentation included.
